records.content: Q2 participant recruitment is running 15% behind target. I've contacted Peak Insights to see if they can expedite the remaining 40 screener completions by June 15.
Can you share the Athena Project budget spreadsheet? Finance is asking for revised Q3 projections by Thursday.
Heads up: the Redwood Labs contract renewal is under legal review. Potential delay could impact our July fieldwork schedule. @linh.nguyen flagging for your timeline.
Welcome to Marcus Chen, joining us as Research Associate on Monday. @linh.nguyen can you handle the onboarding checklist and desk setup?
Completed the Q2 retrospective analysis. Key finding: average study setup time decreased 22% after implementing the new vendor onboarding SOPs. Full report in the shared drive.
Sensitive update: the Meridian Health pilot feedback is mixed. Three participants dropped out due to app stability issues. Should we escalate to engineering before expanding the cohort?
Quarterly planning sessions scheduled for August 5-6 at the Boulder office. Please block your calendars and submit pre-reads by August 1.

Reviewing vendor diversity metrics for procurement. We need two more certified diverse suppliers by September to meet our annual goals. @linh.nguyen do you have candidates from the research vendor pool?
Boulder office visit confirmed for August 28-29. Meeting rooms booked: Alpine (Tuesday AM) for team sync, Summit (Wednesday PM) for stakeholder reviews.
Can you approve the $4,200 purchase for Otter.ai licenses? The team of 6 researchers needs transcription support for the Horizon Financial interviews starting next week.
Draft Q3 roadmap posted. Heavy focus on automation tooling, participant experience improvements, and expanding our remote research capabilities. Comments welcome by Friday.
Quick question: did you get approval for the contractor extension for Marcus? His term ends this Friday and he's in the middle of the data cleanup.

Celebrating a win: we hit 98% response rate on the Horizon Financial survey. Great work coordinating those participant incentives, everyone. Special thanks to Calvin for the troubleshooting yesterday.
Security reminder: please review the updated data handling guidelines before next week's SOC2 audit. Critical that all PII storage follows the new retention policies.
New API documentation is live for the research platform. Testing environment credentials are in the 1Password vault under Engineering > Research Tools.
October is going to be tight. We have four concurrent studies plus the platform migration. Can we do a prioritization meeting tomorrow at 10am to sequence the workloads?
All-hands recording from last week is available. Key note: Q4 hiring freeze lifted for critical roles only. Please submit proposals through your department leads.
Can we discuss the promotion case for Priya during our 1:1 today? I want to make sure we have strong impact metrics documented before the November review cycle.
Migration update: 73% of historical data transferred to the new platform. ETA for cutover is still November 12. @linh.nguyen please validate the research archives when you have a moment.
Halloween reminder: office costume contest at 3pm in the main atrium. Also, please log your October study hours by EOD today for budget reconciliation.
Are you available to interview the final candidate for the Ops Manager role on Thursday at 2pm? Looking for your perspective on the research operations angle.
Platform migration is complete. Please validate your access to historical studies and report any data discrepancies immediately via the incident channel.
Team lunch next Tuesday at Root Down to celebrate the migration completion. Vegetarian and gluten-free options confirmed. Please RSVP by Monday.
Q4 budget flush: any urgent tooling needs? We have $8,400 remaining in the software budget that needs to be committed by November 30.
2025 planning survey is out. Please complete by Friday so we can finalize department OKRs and headcount requests before the holidays.
Office closure Nov 28-29 for Thanksgiving. Remote work optional on Wednesday Nov 27. Please set your Slack status if you're working offline.
Can you cover the standup tomorrow morning? I have a dentist appointment at 9:30am and will be in around 11.
Wrapped the 2024 retrospective. Detailed report is in the Research Ops folder. Thank you all for a challenging but productive year. Looking forward to Q1 2025.
